subject: Air freight quote to JFK
body:
Hi,

Could you quote an all-in price in EUR for the fastest air freight option to JFK (New York, US)? Please arrange truck pickup from our site in 44165 Dortmund, Germany, to the airport. The shipment is ready for pickup on 2026-11-25.

It’s 10 pieces of sports equipment, 102 kg gross and 0.76 cbm.

Mira Petersen
Nordlicht Audio
